newsitem.title: USA: Dell says ups authorized shrs to 1.0 bln.
newsitem.headline: Dell says ups authorized shrs to 1.0 bln.

text.p: Dell Computer Corp said Friday its shareholders approved an increase in the number of authorized shares of its common stock to 1.0 billion from 300 million.
The company said the move allows it to carry out a 2-for-1 stock split authorized in May.
The stock split, the company's fourth in five years and the second in eight months, will be paid on July 25 as a 100 percent stock dividend to shareholders of record as of July 18
The share increase was authorized at the company's annual meeting in Austin, Texas.
Shareholders also approved changes in the company's employee-incentive plan.
